sentences.en: What was the gross income in the previous calendar year?
sentences.zh: 上一个日历年总收入是多少？

sentences.en: The gross national product of our country is the second largest.
sentences.zh: 我国国内生产总值是世界第二。

sentences.en: You must be more careful to avoid making a gross mistake.
sentences.zh: 你必须更仔细些，以免犯下低级错误。
